m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Can I be of service to you, Spellbinder? Help with an ancient curse? Everything turns to sand you say? Mmmhmm, I see.
Yes, I believe I know of an Elixir that will lift the wretched creature's curse, but I lack the proper ingredients.
You will have to bring them to me. First, gather Plumeria Blossoms from the Garden of Vida in Sardonyx.
Then, you will need to wrestle away some of the Weeping Stones the Common Killers chew to stay hydrated in the Kondha Desert.
Did you get the missing Elixir ingredients? Good. Let me have them. Give me a moment to grind the Plumeria Blossoms in...
There we are. Now to extract a few tears from the Weeping Stones... Done! Here, take this Elixir to your poor, sandy friend.
You grok your Moth Priestess-friend can break this curse? Please, you must ask her!
The Moth Priestess groks this Elixir will break my curse? :Cough: Hand it to me, quick-quick!
WAIT! Don't hand it to me! I don't want the Elixir to turn into sand. You'll have to drip-drip it to me!
I feel... clean. Did it work? Spellbinder, hand me the empty Elixir bottle...
It didn't turn to sand! We've broken the Shadow Queen's curse! I owe you two hundred seasons worth of thanks!
When the Shadow Queen came to grok the Solar Arc, I questioned her right to visit the sacred shrine.
With a flick of her fur-less finger, she cast the same fate upon me that she cast upon the forest: a never-die-life of sand.
Everything I touch turns to sand, and I will never grok the sweet gift of death.
No Hopper can break the Shadow Queen's curse, so I must live here in this cave, alone, for all eternity. :Cough:
:Cough: Please ask your Moth Priestess-friend, Logan SpiralGlider, if she groks how to break my curse.
